 Gangbuk-gu: "Apply for Local Tax Refunds by Text or KakaoTalk"
 by Kim Minjin 
 Published 16 Nov.2026 07:43(KST) 
 Share 
 Language 
 Text Size 
 Print 
 Just send your refund number, name, and account number.
 Gangbuk-gu, Seoul (District Mayor Jung Changsoo) announced on Nov. 16 that it is accepting applications for local tax refunds by text message and KakaoTalk. There is no need to visit the district office to receive a refund.
 Provided by Gangbuk-gu.
 View original image 
 Local tax refunds are payments returned to taxpayers who have overpaid or mistakenly paid local taxes. Taxpayers who have received a refund notice or information letter can apply. To apply by text message, send the refund number, name, bank name, and account number. To apply via KakaoTalk, add the "Gangbuk-gu Local Tax Refund" channel or add the ID "gangbuk6476" as a friend, then send the same information.
 Applications can also be submitted by fax, mail, or online. To apply by fax (02-901-5526), fill in the local tax refund account application form with the bank name, account number, and contact information, then send it. To apply by mail, complete the claim form included with the notice, fold it so the sender's information is visible on the outside, and mail it. To apply online, look up the refund on the Seoul Metropolitan Government ETAX website and submit an application.
 Refunds can be collected in cash at any Shinhan Bank branch in Seoul. However, refunds of 500,000 won or more are paid only into the taxpayer's own account. For inquiries, contact the district's Tax Division 1 at 02-901-6476.

 District Mayor Jung Changsoo said, "We provide convenient application options by text message and KakaoTalk so that people do not put off applying because the process of receiving local tax refunds seems cumbersome. We will continue to provide tax administration services that residents can experience as convenient in their daily lives."
